summary: First-run E2E validation for Caremanto Solutions. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (auth cookie, admin 401 gating, projects/gallery/leads CRUD + persistence, taxonomy update). Frontend: home hero 'Redefining spaces with quiet authority.' renders (no more black placeholder), all three nav dropdowns (Interiors, Restoration & Renovation, Gallery with By Space + By Work) open and expose all data-testids, /works filter chips + card->detail navigation works, /gallery renders 8 seeded photos with filter chip, /studio + /approach load, /contact form submits and shows 'Thank you' state, /admin unauth redirects to /admin/login, admin login with seeded credentials succeeds and dashboard shows Projects/Gallery/Leads/Settings tabs.

issues: /api/auth/me returns 401 on every public page load (AuthProvider probes session without checking storage first). Not a bug — just noisy console. Consider suppressing 401 log for the me endpoint or gating the call.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True in server.py is technically invalid per the CORS spec — browsers would reject credentialed requests when origin is wildcard. It currently works because the frontend calls the same origin (ingress proxies /api). Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit preview URL for safety.
Rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login is NOT implemented (auth_testing.md playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts). Not blocking but should be added before production.
send_notification_email failures are logged but swallowed silently — good for UX, but consider surfacing failure count to admin dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 sample projects, 8 gallery photos and admin user on startup. Tests create/delete TEST_-prefixed resources and restore taxonomy after mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Admin console visually verified. If regression needed, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_caremanto.py -v. Emergent email delivery is NOT verified end-to-end — only /api/leads persistence.
